author: ohtadmin
title: Free training academy set for aspiring firefighters
text:
People living and working in Jamestown who want to join the local fire department will have that opportunity through a free training academy.
The program starts at 6:30 p.m. Thursday, Sept. 25, at the firehouse, 50 Narragansett Ave. The training is meant to introduce new volunteers to the service and develop capable first responders who will be able to assist the people of Jamestown in their time of need. According to Ron Barber, deputy chief, this training is ideal for volunteers seeking community service and people looking to build a foundation for a professional career.
The yearlong program, with classes on Thursday nights, will be taught by certified instructors from the Rhode Island Fire Academy. Graduates will become official members of the local fire department.
All equipment will be supplied for the free program. Due to the nature of the emergency work, this training opportunity is available only to volunteers who work or live in Jamestown.
To learn more, e-mail Barber at rbarber@jamestownfd.com.
